name: SurfSense---Backend
description: Open Source Alternative to NotebookLM / Perplexity / Glean, connected to external sources such as search engines (Tavily, Linkup), Slack, Linear, Notion, YouTube, GitHub, Discord and more. This is the backend container.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Path to store app data. Must match Worker

paths.name: Temp Data
paths.description: Path to store temporary data. Must be shared between containers.

variables.name: Database - URL
variables.description: URL of the PostgreSQL database, including port and credentials

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: JWT Secret key for authentication (should be a secure random string)

variables.name: Frontend URL
variables.description: URL of the frontend service, including port

variables.name: Authentication - Type
variables.description: Authentication type (Google OAuth or local email/password)

variables.name: Authentication - Google Client ID
variables.description: Google OAuth Client ID. Required if AUTH_TYPE is set to GOOGLE.

variables.name: Authentication - Google Client Secret
variables.description: Google OAuth Client Secret. Required if AUTH_TYPE is set to GOOGLE.

variables.name: Google - Calendar Redirect URI
variables.description: Redirect URI for Google Calendar OAuth. Must match the one set in Google Cloud Console.

variables.name: Google - Gmail Redirect URI
variables.description: Redirect URI for Google Gmail OAuth. Must match the one set in Google Cloud Console.

variables.name: AirTable - Client ID
variables.description: AirTable OAuth Client ID. Required if using AirTable connector.

variables.name: AirTable - Client Secret
variables.description: AirTable OAuth Client Secret. Required if using AirTable connector.

variables.name: AirTable - Redirect URI
variables.description: Redirect URI for AirTable OAuth. Must match the one set in AirTable developer console.

variables.name: Models - Embedder Model
variables.description: Name of the embedding model (e.g., openai://text-embedding-ada-002, anthropic://claude-v1, mixedbread-ai/mxbai-embed-large-v1)

variables.name: Models - Reranker Model
variables.description: Name of the reranker model (e.g., ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2)

variables.name: Models - Reranker Model Type
variables.description: Type of reranker model (e.g., flashrank)

variables.name: LiteLLM - Text To Speech Service
variables.description: Text-to-Speech API provider for Podcasts (e.g., openai/tts-1, azure/neural, vertex_ai/). See documentation: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/text_to_speech#supported-providers

variables.name: LiteLLM - Text To Speech API Base
variables.description: Base URL for the Text To Speech API. Optional, leave empty to use default.

variables.name: LiteLLM - Text To Speech API Key
variables.description: API Key for the Text To Speech API provider. Required if the provider needs authentication.

variables.name: LiteLLM - Speech To Text Service
variables.description: Speech-to-Text API provider for Podcasts (e.g., openai/whisper-1, local). See documentation: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/audio_transcription#supported-providers

variables.name: LiteLLM - Speech To Text Local Model
variables.description: Local Whisper model size to use if STT_SERVICE is set to local.

variables.name: LiteLLM - Speech To Text API Base
variables.description: Base URL for the Speech To Text API. Optional, leave empty to use default.

variables.name: LiteLLM - Speech To Text API Key
variables.description: API Key for the Speech To Text API provider. Required if the provider needs authentication.

variables.name: Firecrawl - API Key
variables.description: API key for Firecrawl service for web crawling

variables.name: ETL Service
variables.description: Document parsing service

variables.name: Unstructured - API Key
variables.description: API key for Unstructured.io service for document parsing. Required if ETL Service is set to UNSTRUCTURED

variables.name: LlamaCloud - API Key
variables.description: API key for LlamaCloud service for document parsing. Required if ETL Service is set to LLAMACLOUD

variables.name: Redis - URL
variables.description: URL of the Redis instance used as Celery broker, including port

variables.name: Redis - Results URL
variables.description: URL of the Redis instance used as Celery result backend, including port. Must match CELERY_BROKER_URL

variables.name: Electric - User
variables.description: Electric database user

variables.name: Electric - Password
variables.description: Electric database password

variables.name: LangSmith - Tracing
variables.description: Enable LangSmith tracing.

variables.name: LangSmith - Endpoint
variables.description: LangSmith API endpoint. Default is https://api.smith.langchain.com, change only if you know what you're doing.

variables.name: LangSmith - Project Name
variables.description: LangSmith project name.

variables.name: LangSmith - API Key
variables.description: API key for LangSmith tracing. Required if LANGSMITH_TRACING is enabled.

variables.name: Uvicorn - Host
variables.description: Uvicorn host address. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Uvicorn - Port
variables.description: Uvicorn port. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Uvicorn - Log Level
variables.description: Uvicorn log level. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Uvicorn - Loop
variables.description: Uvicorn loop type. Default is asyncio, change only if you know what you're doing.

variables.name: Internal Python Path
variables.description: Internal Python path for the application. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Unstructured Has Patched Loop
variables.description: Unstructured library patched loop. Default is 1, change only if you know what you're doing.

variables.name: LangChain - Tracing V2
variables.description: Not recommended to change.
